column3: grep matches with re2js (RE2, linear time), not RegExp, imported lazily on the first grep
column4: A budget checked between lines cannot stop one RegExp.test call ((a+)+$ took 17.4 s on 31 chars), and refusing nested quantifiers still leaves polynomial blowups (.*.*.*.*b on a 1,000-char line ran past 120 s in node). RE2 bounds every match by input × program size, which is the guarantee dsh tool-fs-search gets from ripgrep's regex; no lookaround or backreferences, as in rg
column5: plugins/files/discovery.test.ts: (a+)+$ and (a|a)*b answer in under 2 s, (?=a) is refused; node probe: (a+)+$ on a 512 KiB line in 72 ms
column6: shipped; re2js 2.10.0 adds about 65 KB gzipped to the Worker bundle, evaluated only when grep first runs
